## Change

Describe the user-visible problem, the final behavior, and any compatibility impact.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Mark environment-dependent or live checks as unverified when they were not run.

- [ ] Relevant tests and type checks pass.
- [ ] Runtime and web artifacts were rebuilt when changed.
- [ ] Product, dependency/license, and package checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, personal configuration, raw sessions, or generated binaries were added.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated when required.
